description: This file defines utility functions, constants, and data structures for managing network interfaces, bridges, ebtables, gateways, and related configuration in an Android virtualization environment. It contains function declarations for creating, destroying, and configuring network components such as tap interfaces, bridges, ebtables, Ethernet and mobile interfaces, and DNSMASQ, along with associated configuration structs.

methods.name: RunExternalCommand
methods.description: Executes an external command specified by a string and returns an integer status code.

methods.name: GetUserName
methods.description: Retrieves the username associated with the provided user ID.

methods.name: AddTapIface
methods.description: Creates a TAP network interface with the specified name.

methods.name: CreateTap
methods.description: Creates a TAP device with the specified name.

methods.name: BringUpIface
methods.description: Brings up the network interface with the given name.

methods.name: ShutdownIface
methods.description: Shuts down the network interface with the given name.

methods.name: DestroyIface
methods.description: Destroys the network interface with the specified name.

methods.name: DeleteIface
methods.description: Deletes the network interface with the specified name.

methods.name: CreateBridge
methods.description: Creates a network bridge with the specified name.

methods.name: DestroyBridge
methods.description: Destroys the network bridge with the specified name.

methods.name: CreateEbtables
methods.description: Creates ebtables rules with the specified parameters.

methods.name: DestroyEbtables
methods.description: Destroys ebtables rules with the specified parameters.

methods.name: EbtablesBroute
methods.description: Configures ebtables Broute rules in the network.

methods.name: EbtablesFilter
methods.description: Configures ebtables filtering rules in the network.

methods.name: CreateMobileIface
methods.description: Creates a mobile network interface with the specified name, id, and IP address.

methods.name: DestroyMobileIface
methods.description: Destroys a mobile network interface with the specified name, id, and IP address.

methods.name: CreateEthernetIface
methods.description: Creates an Ethernet network interface with specified parameters.

methods.name: DestroyEthernetIface
methods.description: Destroys an Ethernet interface with specified parameters.

methods.name: CleanupEthernetIface
methods.description: Cleans up resources associated with an Ethernet interface based on configuration.

methods.name: IptableConfig
methods.description: Configures iptables rules for a given network.

methods.name: LinkTapToBridge
methods.description: Links a tap interface to a bridge.

methods.name: SetupBridgeGateway
methods.description: Sets up a gateway for a network bridge.

methods.name: CleanupBridgeGateway
methods.description: Cleans up gateway configuration for a bridge.

methods.name: CreateEthernetBridgeIface
methods.description: Creates an Ethernet bridge interface with specific IP address.

methods.name: DestroyEthernetBridgeIface
methods.description: Destroys an Ethernet bridge interface with specific IP address.

methods.name: AddGateway
methods.description: Adds a gateway to the network configuration.

methods.name: DestroyGateway
methods.description: Removes a gateway from the network configuration.

methods.name: StartDnsmasq
methods.description: Starts DNSMASQ with specified bridge, gateway, and DHCP range.

methods.name: StopDnsmasq
methods.description: Stops DNSMASQ service for the specified network.
